other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Delhi for more than 5 years before the application date.
The deceased primary breadwinner must have been aged between 18 and 60 years at the time of death.
Applicant must have an Aadhaar number.
Applicant must have a singly‑operated bank account in Delhi for receiving the payment through PFMS.
Relaxations are allowed for minors, mentally challenged applicants, or those under legal guardianship as per National Trust rules.
benefits_summary: One-time cash assistance of Rs 20,000 transferred to the beneficiary's bank account via PFMS.
